description: For cash needed on set dates (a tax payment, a closing, a capital call), each with an amount: among options that pay back or can be withdrawn in time (Treasury bills timed to the date, CDs, no-penalty CDs, savings, a Treasury money fund, checking), what keeps the most after tax by each date, in dollars, with a link that reopens the same plan. Up to 6 dates within three years.

needs.description: Each date the money is needed.

date.description: Date needed, YYYY-MM-DD, after today and within three years.

label.description: What it is for, e.g. "Estimated tax".

niit.description: True if the 3.8% net investment income tax applies.

state_pct.description: State + local income tax rate, e.g. 5. 0 if none.

name: plan_cash_by_date
title: Cash needed by a date: what keeps the most
